description: RM65 side-mounted teleoperation reference defaults; bounded DLS hardware path refreshed on 2026-09-23
notes: Reference snapshot only: the Tyro entrypoint does not load this JSON automatically. Robot base is mounted on a vertical surface. Configure controller realtime UDP push to the runtime host port 8089 before hardware startup.

simulation.home_joint_deg_notes: Set this only after verifying a collision-free side-mount posture. The simulation entrypoint does not load this JSON automatically; pass the same values with --home-joint-deg.

hardware.R_headset_world_notes: Same matrix as the current simulation and safe hardware entrypoints; invert_tcp_xy=False by default. Enabling it flips translation TCP X/Y only. This JSON is not loaded automatically.
hardware.singularity_notes: Official FK with explicit work/base and flange/TCP xyz-wxyz transforms (null means identity); one normalized numerical Jacobian per cycle (linear rows / 0.3 m), bounded local candidates, acknowledged stop on hard hold, constrained J3/J5 outward motion only. A single budget miss keeps the last accepted target; three consecutive misses slow-stop. Not collision avoidance or physical acceptance.
